hooks.command: if [ -f .claude/auto-commit-message.txt ] && [ -s .claude/auto-commit-message.txt ]; then if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then git add -A && git commit -F .claude/auto-commit-message.txt && rm -f .claude/auto-commit-message.txt; fi; fi
